newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end mixed on uncertainties.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end mixed on uncertainties.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mixed on Tuesday because of uncertainty in the market about where prices will go in the short term, traders said.
The most actively traded September 1997 contract ended at 3,180 yuan ($383) per tonne, rising 30 yuan. It opened at 3,180 yuan, hitting an intraday low of 3,177 and a high of 3,190 yuan.
November fell four to 3,166 yuan, the January 1998 contract rose four to 3,152 and March dropped three to 3,145 yuan.
Combined volume rose to 23,500 tonnes from 20,300 tonnes.
Soybeans opened mixed and moved around opening levels for most of the session, traders said.
